body:
First trick = known from the start. Shared moves (the game's 6 today: Spin, Big jump, Flip, Dance, Roll over, High five) get settings per pet (size, speed, which parts move). Gear tricks play on the pet's yard gear.
- Dog, pug, pomchi, sausage dog: High five · Agility jump · Roll over
- Cat: Spin · Tower climb and leap down · High five (paw wave)
- Bunny: Big jump (happy hop) · Hurdle hops · Spin
- Hamster: Spin · Maze run in and out · Roll over (ball curl)
- Capybara: Dance (slow sway) · Spin · Roll over. Gear unknown.
- Duck: Dance (waddle) · Big jump with wing flap · Spin. Gear unknown.
- Owl: Head turn · Perch hop, wings open · Spin
- Monkey: Clap · Swing on the monkey bars · Flip
- Seal: Flipper clap · Ball on the nose · Roll over
- Bear: Sit up and wave · Walk the log · Roll over
- Snake: Sway to the flute · Rise from the charmer basket · Coil spin
Duck and owl wings and a snake tongue now exist (Living chat, 31 Oct), so those tricks can use them.
Plan only today: the GIF comes after your OK.

B) Each dog gets its own first trick
